notes.title: 📢 Update: Level Design tweaks & improved enemy death animations!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

We've just rolled out an update with some improvements to level design and enemy death effects to enhance the gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 [b]Level 1-4 Design Update[/b]

Adjusted layouts and obstacles to improve flow and pacing.
Tweaked enemy placements for better challenge balancing.
Optimized visual elements to enhance immersion.

🦊 [b]Fox Knight death animation & effect overhaul[/b]

The Fox Knight now has a smoother death sequence.
Added a fade-out effect after the death animation for a more cinematic experience.
Improved transitions to ensure a polished and immersive effect.
We hope you enjoy these updates! Let us know your feedback in the discussions or reviews. More improvements coming soon! 🚀
